description: This source file defines a class 'SlugifyParameterTransformer' which implements 'IOutboundParameterTransformer'. The class provides a method to transform route parameters into a slugified, URL-friendly format by inserting hyphens between camel case words and converting the string to lowercase.

classes.name: SlugifyParameterTransformer
classes.description: A class that transforms route parameters into URL-friendly slugs by converting camel case to hyphen-separated lowercase strings.

methods.name: TransformOutbound
methods.description: Converts an object value to a URL slug by inserting hyphens between camel case words and converting to lowercase.
